environment.description: EKS pod running the same container image with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/provisioning-consumer=localhost/k8s-provisioning-restricted. The profile (k8s-provisioning-restricted) denies all file write operations except to /tmp/** and /proc/self/fd/*, denies network connect to any address except the internal NLB endpoint for LDAP (10.0.4.0/24 port 636 only), and denies capability net_raw. Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) and the /var/log/provisioning path is backed by an emptyDir volume with a 10Mi sizeLimit. The LDAP connection is forced through an Envoy sidecar proxy that performs protocol-level inspection and rejects any LDAP search filter containing unescaped parentheses in attribute values (custom Lua filter matching RFC 4515 Section 3 escape requirements).

envoy_sidecar.ldap_filter_lua: validates RFC 4515 escaping in search filter attribute values, rejects filters with unescaped special chars )(\*\0 in value positions
